responsibility: Defines the shared inference-and-obligation state inherited by all `FnCtxt`s within a type-checking root body, including the common `InferCtxt`, mutable body-local `TypeckResults`, local bindings, fulfillment engine, and the deferred work queues for closure-call resolution, cast/transmute/asm checks, coroutine interiors, and delayed `Sized` obligations. It also centralizes registration of trait obligations and records inference-variable relationships used later by fallback and closure/body checking.
